essence: The verse questions whether one underlying thing can remain despite apparent difference.
The verse contrasts causal difference with ultimate difference and asks whether different form can still be one.
The verse challenges whether action can be one agent when nature differs.
The verse says fruit production causes no harm because action is not a separate power for us.
Power is the lord's own power, and the lord is the form of world-self.
